entries.0948666d8d9dfed4: The History section records the successful development of electronic measuring instruments in 1953 and the start of production and sales of DC stabilized power supplies in 1960. The Business Description section states that Kikusui Denshi Kogyo Co., Ltd. carries out research and development, sales and repair, that Kikusui Emuzu Co., Ltd. carries out manufacturing, and that overseas sales subsidiaries carry out sales and repair.
entries.0d7b6af13a266413: These are electronic measuring instruments, such as safety-related test equipment and measuring instruments for aviation electronics.
entries.0e64aeafbf3de5bf: Power supply equipment and electronic measuring instruments.
entries.161e11fc5d1a52e8: Its strength lies in the long accumulation of evaluation and measurement technology since the successful development of electronic measuring instruments in 1953. With a structure in which it develops and manufactures both power supply equipment and measuring instruments in-house and handles everything from sales to repair and calibration across the group, it can respond consistently to customers' needs for evaluation testing and manufacturing equipment.
entries.2cc50b978c97c0a3: Proceeds from sales of power supply equipment.
entries.300e149f8fbe808f: Fees for repair and calibration services.
entries.3548a292b96d7fee: This is a service that repairs and calibrates electrical measuring instruments and other equipment sold.
entries.38242965c27247aa: The holding company of the Kikusui Electronics group, which develops, manufactures, and sells electronic measuring instruments and power supply equipment, and which also provides repair and calibration services.
entries.46ec56ea85ace61f: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,609 million, up 11.8% from ¥1,439 million in the previous fiscal year. Growth in revenue supported the increase in profit.
entries.6bc4ff396245fa3e: These are power supply equipment such as DC power supplies, AC power supplies and electronic loads.
entries.72f666a51aa43d1a: It provides power supply equipment, such as DC power supplies, AC power supplies and electronic loads, and electronic measuring instruments, led by safety-related test equipment, and also provides repair and calibration services. Research and development, sales and repair are handled by Kikusui Denshi Kogyo Co., Ltd., while manufacturing is handled by Kikusui Emuzu Co., Ltd.
entries.7d10f664676551b4: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,687 million, up 9.4% from ¥13,429 million in the previous fiscal year. Power supply equipment accounted for ¥10,762 million, electronic measuring instruments for ¥3,369 million, and repair and calibration services, among others, for ¥555 million, capturing capital investment demand in the in-vehicle, energy, semiconductor and data center markets, among others.
entries.8d5cdb7a6852e888: This is a service that repairs and calibrates electrical measuring instruments and other equipment sold. In addition to Japan, repairs are also carried out at sales subsidiaries in China, the United States, Europe and India. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥555 million.
entries.9439da19261217f9: These are electronic measuring instruments, such as safety-related test equipment and measuring instruments for aviation electronics. Safety-related test equipment is sold to the battery-related market for withstand voltage and insulation resistance testing of EV batteries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,369 million.
entries.973615f429c210f5: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells electrical measuring instruments and related equipment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,687 million. Kikusui Denshi Kogyo Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, handles research and development, sales and repair, and Kikusui Emuzu Co., Ltd. handles manufacturing; the business also sells and repairs products overseas through sales subsidiaries in China, the United States, Germany and India.
entries.b577f5cf0249aa16: Proceeds from sales of electronic measuring instruments.
entries.bd6dcceb5d3f14bd: It designates four priority markets (e-mobility, next-generation energy, power semiconductors and data centers) and sells to makers in in-vehicle, battery and semiconductor-related fields, among others. Sales are made through sales agents such as Nihon Denkei Co., Ltd. as well as directly, and sales subsidiaries in China, the United States, Germany and India are responsible for overseas sales.
entries.c47b48d8023b3514: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells electrical measuring instruments and related equipment.
entries.c71feecda844d363: These are power supply equipment such as DC power supplies, AC power supplies and electronic loads. They are sold for evaluation testing and manufacturing equipment in the automotive-related, energy-related, semiconductor-related, data center-related and space industry markets, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,762 million.
entries.ca97539f110fd51e: Markets such as automotive, energy and semiconductors.
entries.cb7485c33d55601a: It is a structure in which, as a holding company overseeing the group, its subsidiaries develop and manufacture power supply equipment and electronic measuring instruments, sell them to markets such as automotive, energy and semiconductors, and also earn revenue from repair and calibration.
entries.da987e644a9abe1c: It is a company whose predecessor was Kikusui Denpa Kenkyusho, founded in 1949, and it shifted to a holding company structure in October 2022. Its head office is in Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and it is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. As of March 31, 2026, it had 345 consolidated employees and 7 consolidated subsidiaries.
